Title: New planned datacenter region in Georgia (East US 3)

Body.Content:
Customers and partners in the United States will benefit from cloud services. Availability Zones in the new East US 3 region will provide customers with high availability and additional tolerance to datacenter failures. The new datacenter region will have a presence in Douglas and Fulton counties, in response to growing customer demand, supporting the creation of new jobs and local business growth.

Learn more.
